Headline: Red Line Service Delayed at 95th
ShortDescription: UPDATE! Red Line riders trains are standing at 95th due to signal problems. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Red Line riders trains are standing at 95th due to signal problems. 

Shuttles buses have been requested from Garfield to 95th to provide connecting service through the affected area in both directions.

At this time also consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#29 State

#24 Wentworth

#95 95th

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
